title: Deal
description: Represents a programmatic deal on an SSP platform. Created from one or more curated segments. Each deal maps 1:1 to an SSP deal — multi-platform activation requires separate deals per SSP.

deal_id.description: Protocol-level deal identifier. Used in all protocol calls (get_deals, update_deal, etc.). Maps to sale_id in the curator's internal systems.

buyer_ref.description: Buyer's reference identifier for this deal. Used for idempotency — curator deduplicates on buyer_ref + account.

buyer_campaign_ref.description: Buyer's campaign reference label. Groups related operations under a single campaign.

status.description: Current deal status in the lifecycle

deal_type.description: Type of SSP deal. Immutable after creation.

platform.description: SSP platform where this deal is activated

ssp_deal_id.description: SSP-assigned deal ID, generated by the SSP on activation. Buyers use this ID to target the deal in their DSP.

dsps.description: DSP configurations for this deal. Each entry represents a DSP that can bid on this deal.

dsp_id.description: DSP identifier (numeric or string depending on the SSP)

seat_id.description: Buyer's seat ID on the SSP for this DSP. Provided by the buyer in the request; the SSP routes the deal to this seat.

buyer_deal_id.description: DSP-specific deal ID, populated after activation. The buyer uses this ID within their DSP to target the deal.

curator_fee.description: Curator fee transparency. Optional — only present when the curator discloses fee structure (see curator_fee_disclosure in get_adcp_capabilities).

fee_type.description: How the curator's margin is structured

fee_amount.description: Fee amount — percentage (0-100) for 'percentage' type, or CPM amount for 'flat_cpm' type

ad_format_types.description: Ad format types for this deal

start_time.description: Campaign start date/time in ISO 8601 format

end_time.description: Campaign end date/time in ISO 8601 format

created_at.description: Timestamp when the deal was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to this deal

sandbox.description: When true, this deal was created in sandbox mode with simulated data.
